Delivered the complete independent persistence B01 result-and-plan scientific review for the fixed task at cf87e93333af7870aa5b2d5cbd7afb4d181ba3f0.

[Read the complete review at delivery commit 5f49770d9d87aa952a1894b522056ce158000545](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/5f49770d9d87aa952a1894b522056ce158000545/docs/research/candidates/vap_folr_core/pro_packets/20260914_persistence_b01_result_plan_review/archive/RESPONSE.md).

All 123 lines, including reference definitions, were read back at that commit. Comparison with its actual parent 7914acbb720474d7d9c18517245a3700ed5c1d23 confirms one commit adding only the authorized RESPONSE.md on codex/vap-folr; concurrent branch changes are preserved.

The review identifies no result-invalidating defect in the documented A–Z observation. It preserves CURRENT_ONLY_ABOVE_MEI at its fitted-program scope and recommends preparation of the posed fresh Z–G comparison, with explicit outcome-informed selection, temporal-capacity/optimization, unequal-program and cost limits. It retains repeat A–G/A–Z as substantive alternatives, the original prediction miss, all historical outcomes and observation/cleanup limitations. This is scientific advice within the posed object-tier question, not an empirical launch, paid grant, Portfolio disposition or family/lifecycle change.

No scientific code, test, model/checkpoint load, raw-result reanalysis or experiment was executed. This delivery changed no other repository file, previous response or branch. The DM retains the full-review intake and response to material findings.
